item.title: How to watch Seattle Seahawks NFC championship game
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks have advanced to the NFC championship and will play again this weekend. Here's how to watch it live.

item.title: Ken Walker III rushes for 3 TDs as Seattle Seahawks roll to NFC championship
item.description: Several Seahawks players hit significant achievements on the field Saturday night in the team's resounding win over longtime rivals, the San Francisco 49ers.

item.title: Dry, sunny weather lingers in Seattle
item.description: Fresh mountain snow and lowland rain aren't expected until later in the work week. Next weekend is trending cloudier, cooler and wetter.

item.title: Rashid Shaheed's touchdown causes seismic spike in Seattle, Seahawks NFC championship bound
item.description: Seismologists say Seattle fans were so excited by an early game touchdown that the cheering spectators actually caused a rumble in the area that some fans are now calling the “Rashidquake."

item.title: Seattle Reddit users furious over Seahawks parking prices
item.description: Though fans celebrated a resounding Seahawks win against the San Francisco 49ers on Saturday, getting to the game itself caused some frustration among fans driving to the Lumen Field game.

item.title: Seattle weather: Calm end to weekend, chilly sun on horizon
item.description: With a nice PNW dry sunny weekend coming to a close, we look at conditions for the upcoming work week including late-week rain chances.

item.title: 12-year-old arrested for screwdriver attack in Seattle’s Central District
item.description: Police report a 12-year-old in a hot pink ski mask attacked a woman with a screwdriver and robbed her in Seattle over the weekend.

item.title: Takeaways from Seattle Seahawks 41-6 rout of 49ers in NFC divisional round
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks delivered an emphatic statement by easily dispatching a short-handed San Francisco 49ers in a 41-6 romp to reach their fourth NFC championship game in franchise history.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks to play Los Angeles Rams in NFC championship
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks will face the Los Angeles Rams in the NFC championship game as the Rams advanced with a 20-17 overtime victory over the Chicago Bears on Sunday night.

item.title: Hannah Brandt, Aerin Frankel rally Fleet to 2-1 shootout win over Torrent
item.description: Hannah Brandt had the only goal in a shootout and Aerin Frankel finished with 36 saves to help the Boston Fleet pull out a 2-1 victory over the Seattle Torrent at Climate Pledge Arena on Sunday night.
